node.statement: For contractions x,y in B, set a=Delta x, b=Delta y, a0=Phi Delta x, b0=Phi Delta y. Node 1.1 makes all four contractions and the diagonal range of Phi gives [a0,b0]=0; node 1.2 gives ||a-a0||,||b-b0||<=2*epsilon. Hence ||[Delta x,Delta y]||<=||[a-a0,b]||+||[a0,b-b0]||<=2(2*epsilon)+2(2*epsilon)=8*epsilon. Applying the multiplicativity hypothesis to (x,y) and (y,x), and contractivity of Upsilon, yields ||[x,y]||<=||xy-Upsilon(Delta x Delta y)||+||Upsilon([Delta x,Delta y])||+||Upsilon(Delta y Delta x)-yx||<=10*epsilon.
